title: Merge sort with two read indices
summary: Recursively sort two halves and merge them into a fresh list. Take equal keys from the left to preserve their input order.
code: while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
triggers: stable sort by merging sorted runs
two read indices advancing through sorted halves
prompts: Sort transactions by timestamp while retaining input order within a timestamp.
Combine recursively sorted batches into one stable ordering of records.
invariant: The merged prefix contains the smallest consumed items in stable order.
mantra: Take the smaller front and append the remaining tail.
pitfalls: Taking from the right on a tie reverses equal keys across the split.

anchors.name: Sort an Array
anchors.trick: Divide the range and merge its sorted halves.

complexity.time: O(n log n) for constant-time keys

mutations.explanation: Lets a later item precede an earlier item with the same key.
